aggregation: per (dataset, method, learner): mean of the available split cells; a (dataset, method, learner) with fewer than 3 of 5 splits available is unavailable
per (dataset, method) for a pairwise comparison: mean over the learners available for both methods on that dataset
per (dataset, method) for Friedman / average ranks: mean over the learners available for every method in the set; only datasets where every method in the set is available enter
every unavailable cell is listed with its reason and counted; no dataset is dropped silently

tests.success_family: Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided (scipy zero_method='wilcox', exact where available), merged vs tuned no oversampling and merged vs U2, Holm over these two
tests.comparator_family: Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided, merged vs each other comparator, Holm over that family
tests.intervals: median paired difference with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval over datasets (10,000 resamples, seed 13)
tests.ranks: average ranks + Friedman test over the main methods (merged, tuned no oversampling, class-weighted, SMOTE, U2, paper-derived UGO, quality-coverage, random)
tests.metrics: the primary metric (F1) for every test; MCC only for the success criterion's no-loss check; AP, recall, coverage and redundancy descriptive

statistics.no_other_tests: no other test is reported as a test; everything else is descriptive (counts, medians)

Final wording and size target fixed at Gate 2. Superseded by success_criterion at the Gate 2 draft.

final_evaluation.design: U2's own protocol: per (method, learner), every candidate of candidate_parameters (U2 search spaces, default first, N_CANDIDATES) is fitted on inner TRAIN (minus removals) + the method's synthetic minority rows and scored on the 20% VALIDATION carve; U2's rule (choose_f1_threshold, then _better) picks the candidate and threshold; the choice is refitted on TRAIN (+ the same rows) and scored once on REAL TEST at that threshold (study/v3/u3_eval.py, pinned ml_ugo code unmodified)
final_evaluation.deviation_from_gate_1_decision_2: Gate 1 decision 2 replaced the single 20% carve by 5-fold cross-fitting. Cross-fitting is used for Phase 2 method design only. The final evaluation keeps U2's single 20% VALIDATION carve because cross-fitting needs about 5x the fits (200 units x ~20 methods x 5 learners x N_CANDIDATES), which this machine cannot run in the study's time. Declared here as a compute deviation; it applies equally to every method.
final_evaluation.svm_policy: an RBF SVM cell whose training set exceeds 20,000 rows is reported unavailable (SVM_SIZE_LIMIT) for every method alike; probability-enabled SVC does not finish on the largest datasets on this machine
final_evaluation.mlp_class_weight: U2's MLP has no class weight: the class-weighted comparator is unavailable for the MLP (NO_CLASS_WEIGHT_IN_U2_MLP)
final_evaluation.tuned_no_oversampling: the no-oversampling method with the same candidate search and threshold rule
final_evaluation.refusal: u3_eval.py refuses to read TEST unless --expected-protocol-sha256 equals the SHA-256 of this file (CRLF normalized) recorded in STATUS.md Gates

success_criterion: Met when, across the benchmark datasets: (1) the median paired F1 difference of the merged method minus tuned no oversampling is > 0 and its Holm-adjusted two-sided Wilcoxon p < 0.05; (2) the same for merged minus U2; and (3) neither MCC comparison against those two shows a loss, i.e. not (median MCC difference < 0 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05). No minimum effect size beyond > 0 (as proposed at Gate 1). A miss is reported as found.

merged_method.pool: union: pool:smote + pool:u2_native + pool:u2_flow_gate (4 x B each, U2-side, pinned ml_ugo code) + every LLM pool covering the unit; integer_rounding_v3 where integer fields are declared
merged_method.selection: utility_filter keeps rho of the admitted pool by the term (ties by SHA-256 of occurrence id), then quality-coverage to budget B (seed 42)
merged_method.source: Phase 2 LR/RF screen pick (report/phase2/selection); kept after the five-learner check (report/phase2/five-learner/NOTES.md: +0.0003 F1 vs random, 3/5 learners; all designs within about +/-0.003)
